---
title: "httr::modify_url() replaces the path instead of extending it"
ref: ERR-03
categories: [Errors and files]
impact: incoherent
extrait: 'modify_url("https://api.fr/v1/", path = "users")'
reponse: '"https://api.fr/users"'
attendu: "`\"https://api.fr/v1/users\"`"
versions: "All versions of {httr}"
source: "Slack ThinkR (2022)"
---

::: {.piege packages="httr"}
```{r}
suppressPackageStartupMessages(library(httr))

base <- "https://api.example.com/v1/"
modify_url(base, path = "users")
```
:::

## Why

`modify_url()` splits the address into pieces (scheme, host, path, query), replaces the ones you give it, then glues everything back together. So the `path` argument replaces the whole path, and the `v1/` of the base address disappears. The request goes to a different address, which may well exist and answer something else.

## The fix

Build the full path from the one in the base address. With {httr2}, `req_url_path_append()` does exactly that.

::: {.piege packages="httr"}
```{r}
suppressPackageStartupMessages(library(httr))

full_path <- paste0(parse_url(base)$path, "users")
modify_url(base, path = full_path)
```
:::
